properties.name: Core model types (Schema, Value, DynoError)
properties.spec:
REQUIRED FROM dynograph-foundation. reflow2 links `dynograph-core`, pinned by git tag v0.12.0.

NAMED TO MATCH THE PUBLISHER DELIBERATELY, and that is a finding rather than a convenience. The first attempt declared ONE umbrella interface for the whole dynograph dependency; pairing returned NINE candidates and ZERO pairs, because a pair needs a name match at or above 85/100 and an umbrella scores 62-78 against nine crisp names. Two causes, and the first was ours: THEY DECOMPOSED AND WE LUMPED. reflow2 links five named crates that map 1:1 onto five of their published interfaces, so the honest model is five requirements at their granularity.

THE SECOND CAUSE IS WORTH REPORTING UPSTREAM: pairing matches on NAME similarity, so a long explanatory name systematically undershoots the bar while a short parallel one clears it. That rewards naming an interface for the contract rather than describing it — defensible — but it means the seam is only as good as two teams independently choosing similar words, and nothing says so.
